description:
Security Removable Media Manager.

In a perfect world, you would want the computers in your environment to be protected from malicious Removable Media incidents while still allowing proper use of them as productivity aids. This is where secRMM comes in. secRMM protects your data from unauthorized use by employees and hackers alike.
- Updated openssl to version 3.6.2.0 for apple mobile devices since Defender was issuing vulnerabilities.
- Added ability to exclude devices (by internal id) from BitLocker enforcement.
- Modify 'secRMMSafeCopy feature to create encrypted CD/DVD/Blu-ray discs' to better handle hardend systems (i.e. with DOD STIGS applied) - take 5.
